title: TELLURATE COMPLEXES OF NICKEL, PALLADIUM, AND PLATINUM, AND A PERIODATE COMPOUND OF NICKEL
abstract: The periodate or tellurate complexes of nickel, palladium, and platinum have been examined. The preparation of NaNi2IO6•2H2O, NaNi4(H3TeO6)3•6H2O, Na6Ni(H3TeO6)3•H2O, Na9H5Ni2 (TeO6)3, Na5H3Pd(TeO6)2•4H2O, and Na5H3Pt(TeO6)2•2H2O is described.
